---
name: Feature request
about: An addition or change you would like to see. Read the README "Scope" section before filing.
labels: enhancement
---

### What you want

One or two sentences describing the change.

### Why it matters for AEOS specifically

AEOS is deliberately small. Changes that turn it into a Unix clone are out of scope. Tell us what this enables for someone reading or modifying the kernel that the current code doesn't.

### Sketch

If you have an implementation sketch or a pointer to how a similar system handles it, link it here. Otherwise leave this empty.

### Out of scope reminder

The README lists what AEOS deliberately does not have (no MMU, no userspace, no SMP, no networking, no RTC). If your request is in that list, it will be closed.
